name: gymkhana-database-workspace
description: Private workspace for the Gymkhana Database application.

scripts.deploy:web:staging: node scripts/require-vite-api-base.mjs && NODE_ENV=production pnpm build:web && wrangler deploy
scripts.build:api:linux: mkdir -p .tmp && COMMIT=$(git rev-parse HEAD) && VERSION=sha-$(git rev-parse --short=12 HEAD) && BUILT_AT=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) && CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -ldflags "-X github.com/Pherlsz/Gymkhana-Database/internal/platform/releaseinfo.Version=$VERSION -X github.com/Pherlsz/Gymkhana-Database/internal/platform/releaseinfo.Commit=$COMMIT -X github.com/Pherlsz/Gymkhana-Database/internal/platform/releaseinfo.BuiltAt=$BUILT_AT" -o .tmp/api ./cmd/api
scripts.format: oxfmt apps scripts workers .github package.json tsconfig.base.json vitest.config.ts vitest.setup.ts oxlint.json pnpm-workspace.yaml wrangler.jsonc wrangler.api.jsonc --write
scripts.format:check: oxfmt apps scripts workers .github package.json tsconfig.base.json vitest.config.ts vitest.setup.ts oxlint.json pnpm-workspace.yaml wrangler.jsonc wrangler.api.jsonc --check
scripts.generate:openapi:ts: openapi-typescript api/openapi.yaml -o apps/web/src/generated/api.ts && openapi-typescript api/search.openapi.yaml -o apps/web/src/generated/search-api.ts && openapi-typescript api/operations.openapi.yaml -o apps/web/src/generated/operations-api.ts && openapi-typescript api/google-forms.openapi.yaml -o apps/web/src/generated/google-forms-api.ts && openapi-typescript api/query.openapi.yaml -o apps/web/src/generated/query-api.ts && openapi-typescript api/matching.openapi.yaml -o apps/web/src/generated/matching-api.ts && openapi-typescript api/chat.openapi.yaml -o apps/web/src/generated/chat-api.ts && openapi-typescript api/ocr.openapi.yaml -o apps/web/src/generated/ocr-api.ts
scripts.check:web: pnpm typecheck:web && pnpm lint:web && pnpm format:check && pnpm test:web && pnpm bundle:check
